Observed

  • A flat pink navigation bar sits above a flat violet hero with a faint grid.
  • The headline is a heavy geometric sans-serif in black.
  • The signup card has a black outline and a solid black shadow. The subscribe button is a white pill with a black outline.
  • Small coin and banknote illustrations have black outlines.
  • A black band carries white statistics text.

Why it belongs

A moderate application of the style: the card and illustrations follow it, but the pill buttons and thin outlines soften it.
